Perks › Common

First Blood

Common perk · Scoring bonus

Your first scoring play of each round adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

Your first play of each hand that actually scores gains +5 points for each copy.

  • "Actually scores" means points were added to your score. A play that a malus reduced to zero (such as Five Jinx on a total of 5) does not use up First Blood; it waits for your next scoring play.
  • It resets at the start of every hand.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 120 Bone Bucks.
